system.prerequisites: Lumari heritage, Lantern of the Last Road, Level 5
system.description:
AURA DIVINITY ESHARI

Your lantern-light falls upon more than the physical world.
While your racial light is active, disembodied spirits and incorporeal undead within 10 feet cannot benefit from Concealment against you merely because they are incorporeal or spiritually manifested.
In addition, a living ally within your light who is Dying gains a +1-status bonus to Dying recovery checks. Your light does not reveal creatures that are genuinely Invisible for another reason.

Prerequisites Lumari heritage, Lantern of the Last Road, Level 5

A rule for the table while your light is active (the aura's +1 status to a Dying ally's recovery checks is offered in that dialog).

conditionals.label: Beacon for the Departing
conditionals.scope: A Dying recovery check by a living ally within your active light
